title: Mandatory backend tests landed — data-quality queue, dashboard KPIs, idempotency on transfer/return/reserve
objective: Verify the Cycle-3 mandatory test additions (design §2.5) exist and pass: FR-028 issue-queue tests, full dashboard KPI set tests (TC-FR-020-04 gap), Idempotency-Key replay tests for transfer/return/reserve.
steps: Collect test inventory; verify presence of data-quality tests (issue flagging, severity, resolve), dashboard KPI tests (overdue returns, maintenance due, warranty expiring, missing, by-category), and idempotent replay tests for transfer/return/reserve.
If any mandatory class is absent → FAILED with defect citing §2.5 mandate.
expected_result: Suite green AND contains all three mandated coverage classes; on success, QA re-executes TC-FR-028-01/02, TC-FR-020-04, and TC-D08-03 as PASSED with the new evidence.

title: Planning-volume performance check — ~100k assets dataset
objective: Generate the planning-volume dataset (design §10.4 C3 command, ~100k assets) and measure dashboard p95 ≤3s, filtered search p95 ≤2s, asset detail p95 ≤2s; verify indexes used (no seq-scan hot paths) and no N+1.
preconditions: Volume-generation command delivered; environment with PostgreSQL able to host the dataset (compose or local); timing harness.
test_data: generated ~100k assets + related assignments/events; 20+ timed samples per endpoint
steps: Run the volume-generation command; record duration and row counts.
Measure dashboard summary, representative filtered searches, and asset detail latencies (min/median/p95).
Spot-check query plans for hot endpoints (index usage); run any assertNumQueries tests.
Record all numbers as evidence; if the environment cannot host the volume, document the largest tested dataset + manual procedure.
expected_result: Targets met at planning volume, or precise measured deviations filed as defects with data; generation command idempotent/re-runnable and separate from seed_dev; results documented in release notes.
automation_status: automatable where environment hosts the volume; else MANUAL with documented procedure

title: Backup/restore procedure documented and walkthrough-drilled
objective: Verify a written backup/restore procedure exists (PostgreSQL encrypted backups, attachment storage coordination, RTO ≤8h / RPO ≤24h interim) and execute a walkthrough restore drill on a disposable database, verifying data + audit-chain integrity after restore.
preconditions: Procedure document delivered; disposable PostgreSQL available (local instance suffices); pg_dump/pg_restore or documented tooling present.
steps: Review the procedure for completeness (scope, encryption, attachments, scheduling, roles, RTO/RPO mapping).
Execute a backup of the seeded DB; drop/restore into a fresh DB per the document.
Verify row counts on key tables and audit hash-chain integrity post-restore; verify app boots against restored DB if feasible.
expected_result: Document accurate enough to follow without tribal knowledge; drill succeeds with zero data discrepancy and intact audit chain; gaps filed as defects. If tooling unavailable in QA env → MANUAL with the drill script attached.
automation_status: partially automatable; likely MANUAL for full drill

title: Cycle-3 security sweep — new endpoints inherit all controls
objective: Verify every C3 endpoint (reservations, approvals, notifications, reports, admin, retire/dispose/reopen, data-quality) enforces authentication, role/scope authorization, CSRF, error-envelope shape, and rate limiting where documented — no control gaps on the new surface.
preconditions: C3 endpoints live in OpenAPI; backend test suite.
test_data: unauthenticated requests to each new endpoint; employee-role mutation attempts; missing-CSRF POST probes; OpenAPI diff review
steps: Probe each new endpoint without session → expect 401 envelope.
Probe mutations as employee → expect 403 PERMISSION_DENIED.
Probe one new POST without CSRF (enforce_csrf_checks) → 403.
Review OpenAPI diff for accidentally-public or permission-missing operations.
expected_result: Uniform control enforcement across the new surface (401/403/404 per contract, ADR-007); no endpoint ships with default-deny bypass; findings filed as defects with severity.

title: Final responsive/a11y execution attempt — C3 pages + carried C1/C2 pages
objective: Final attempt at the browser matrix (responsive breakpoints, axe zero critical/serious, keyboard pass) covering new C3 pages (/reservations, /approvals, /reports, /notifications, /admin/*) plus previously blocked pages; if the environment still lacks a browser, produce the documented manual-verification procedure per §17.
test_data: viewport matrix; axe-core; keyboard-only pass on J-5 and approvals journeys
steps: Probe for browser runner; if present, execute the responsive + axe + keyboard suites and capture evidence.
If absent: verify manual-verification procedures are documented for each remaining blocked UI case (steps, expected results, sign-off checklist) and mark cases MANUAL/BLOCKED accordingly.
expected_result: Executed evidence for the matrix, or honest MANUAL/BLOCKED statuses with complete documented procedures — never silent passes; status recorded in release statement.
automation_status: automatable if browser present; else documentation verification
